page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top right, catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: illud intelligendū est, illam definitionem ei persone accommodatā à Cicerone de industria fuisse, quā in ea disputatione temporis causla M. Antonio affinxerat, ut de Iurisconsultorum dignitate & gloria, quoad posset, detraheret. Deinceps igitur, quorum ea tanta potestas auctori-tasq; fuerit, uideamus. Ac primis quidem temporibus Iurisconsulti à semetipsis eam auctoritatem sumebãt, cum scilicet eos se esse profiterentur, quos uulgò ab omnibus consuli liceret. qua de re Põ-ponij testimonium subscri-bã ex L.2.D. de Orig. iur. An «

page.notes: The "«" at the end of the last line is printed and is kept as printed. The line-end hyphens "Põ-", "subscri-", "quo-" (in "quorum"), "profiteren-" and "aucto-" are kept as printed. "detraheret" has no printed hyphen at the line end, so it is written whole. "Põ" is read as Pomponius with a tilde over the o. The tilde over "sumebãt" and "subscribã" is read as a tilde over a. The dot-like marks at the lower left and the small marks on the right edge are stains and are not transcribed.
